blocking_findings.finding: The SHA-256 assignment is not an executable randomization contract and is not demonstrably independent of stream generation. The same undifferentiated seed names both the stream cohort and assignment; tuple framing, byte encoding, digest-to-uniform conversion, threshold, and assignment-domain separation are unspecified. Sequential exchangeability cannot be mechanically established.

The stated conditional causal excursion estimand is not identified by the stated working regression without an exact linear effect-model assumption. The centered regression coefficient represents the treatment-minus-skip contrast, while the declared estimand is skip-minus-treatment; the assessment rule is sign-consistent but the protocol does not bind tau_H(c)=-(beta_0+beta_1*c). Outcome loss timing and the exact online weighted/ridge SGD recurrence are also unspecified.

The 256-item fit, tune, and assessment thirds are not divisible by the nine-item anchor stride. The protocol does not define per-split anchor origins, incomplete-window disposal, whether any H-step outcome crosses a split, reset behavior, or the exact tune-snapshot state. This permits fit updates from tune outcomes or tune eligibility from assessment outcomes.

The synthetic stream names do not bind generator equations, versioned source digests, shift points, delayed-reward construction, feature dimensions, loss definitions, oracle features, or event semantics. Implementers could select scientifically material fixtures after review.

The primary analysis is not executable. Family-level seed aggregation, loss scaling across multi-stream families, paired test statistic, sidedness, variance-zero behavior, Holm ordering and ties, adjusted-p computation, and qualifying-family decision order are not specified. The verified 0.833077 power number is only a normal-approximation calculation and is not bound to a declared analysis procedure.

Adaptation lag has no operational definition. Shift or reward-onset anchors, recovery target, baseline window, censoring, nonrecovering runs, aggregation, and statistical or deterministic noninferiority rules are absent, so the adaptation gate can fail open.

Resource accounting is not reproducible. The protocol does not define an operation-count algebra for forward prediction, gradients, sparse features, model updates, estimator predictions and updates; the exact eight state scalars and their lifecycle are unnamed; event-count semantics are undefined; and family resource aggregation is unspecified.

Noise-floor, oracle-feature, and no-moderation controls are mandatory but have no preregistered pass or falsification criteria. The mechanism gate omits no_moderation and requires only untested mean differences against two ablations, so the claimed selective-credit mechanism can qualify without demonstrating learnable-versus-unlearnable discrimination or context moderation.

Tune eligibility and lock ordering are underspecified. No tune pass/fail quantities or thresholds are declared, no canonical snapshot payload/digest is defined, and no independent validator contract prevents assessment construction or reading before the lock is accepted.

digest_canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(payload_without_review_digest, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=True)

nonblocking_findings.finding: The fixed H=8, gamma=0.9, stride=9, p=0.5 design is coherent in principle and can prevent overlapping proximal windows once split-local anchoring is specified.
The assessment action beta_0+beta_1*c<0 is directionally consistent with the declared skip-minus-treatment benefit, but that sign identity must be explicit and validator-enforced.

The recomputed two-sided normal-approximation power at alpha=0.0125, n=48, and standardized effect 0.5 is 0.8330770040094296. This arithmetic is correct but does not repair the missing test and composite-gate power contract.
The guard closure, batch-one/no-replay boundary, V2 receipt exclusion, real-execution seal, claim ceiling, and Astral isolation are explicit and internally consistent.

Micro-randomization and weighted-centered regression are correctly treated as established methods rather than novel inventions. The cited doubly robust and expected-trace work is not implemented by the frozen estimator and must not be used to imply those properties.

required_validator_checks: Reject unless protocol, review, implementation source, lock, result, and closure digests match exact allowlisted bytes.

Recompute every assignment from independently custodied data_seed and assignment_seed values using a specified domain tag, length-delimited UTF-8 encoding, unsigned digest interpretation, and exact p=0.5 threshold; reject seed overlap or assignment imbalance outside a preregistered hard bound.
Reject any anchor or proximal outcome window that crosses fit, tune, or assessment boundaries; recompute split-local anchor indices and require empty pending state at every boundary.
Recompute pre-update H-step discounted outcomes, centered design rows, coefficient recurrences, ridge terms, and tau sign mapping from immutable event rows.

Require fit-only estimator mutation, frozen tune coefficients, a canonical tune snapshot and lock digest, no assessment materialization before lock acceptance, and byte-identical snapshot restoration.
Require exactly one Experience per observe call, no replay, no hidden accumulation, no minibatch normalization, causal preprocessing only, and zero future-field access.

Recompute per-seed stream endpoints, predeclared family aggregation, paired statistics, Holm adjusted p-values, adaptation lag, ablation comparisons, and all gate predicates with fixed tie and nonfinite-value handling.

Recompute every model update, skipped update, forward operation, gradient operation, estimator operation, active synaptic operation, state byte, replay byte, event count, and family resource aggregate under a frozen counting algebra.
Require noise-floor and oracle-feature falsification gates and the declared no-moderation, horizon-one, and random-policy ablations; reject missing arms or post-review changes.

Reject real-stream execution unless a synthetic candidate receipt independently validates and a separate exact execution review binds fresh custody, matrices, backends, campaign manifest, statistics, and a new privileged energy protocol.
Reject any plasticity-guard execution or retuning, V2 energy reuse, Astral input or output, benchmark promotion, SOTA claim, publication claim, model-bearing execution, or production traffic.
